exercises.q: Но все это представлялось ему словно сквозь ___ (сетка, acc. sg.).
exercises.why: **сетка → сетку** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -а — declines like DLI's сестра: A. сестру. Ending -а → -у.  Declension: sg. сетка · сетки · сетке · сетку · сеткой · сетке; pl. сетки · сеток · сеткам · сетки · сетками · сетках.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Я сидел на бугре, смотрел через ___ (городок, acc. sg.) на кладбище.
exercises.why: **городок → городок** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a hard consonant — declines like DLI's дом: A. дом. Ending — (no ending) → — (no ending).  Declension: sg. городок · городка · городку · городок · городком · городке; pl. городки · городков · городкам · городки · городками · городках.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

Declension: sg. колодезь · колодезя · колодезю · колодезь · колодезем · колодезе; pl. колодези · колодезей · колодезям · колодези · колодезями · колодезях.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Сосредоточенно гудя, звуки медленно плыли сквозь ___ (серая муть, acc. sg.).
exercises.why: **муть → муть** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -ь — declines like DLI's часть: A. часть. Ending -ь → -ь.  **серый → серую** (acc. sg. f., agreeing with муть). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новая: A. новую. Ending -ая → -ую.  Declension: sg. муть · мути · мути · муть · мутью · мути; pl. мути · мутей · мутям · мути · мутями · мутях.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Надя засмеялась сквозь ___ (неостывшая слеза, acc. pl.) детски радостным, трепетным, тихим смехом.
exercises.why: **слеза → слезы** (acc. pl.). Feminine, inanimate; nominative plural слёзы; declines like DLI's слова (hard stem): A. слова. Ending -а → -ы.  **неостывший → неостывшие** (acc. pl., agreeing with слезы). Adjective type IV, sibilant (after ж, ч, ш, щ) — declines like DLI's хорошие: A. anim. = G., inan. = N.. Ending -ие → -ие.  Declension: sg. слеза · слезы · слезе · слезу · слезой · слезе; pl. слёзы · слёз · слезам · слёзы · слезами · слезах.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Notice that the adjectives of the "soft", "guttural" and "sibilant" types are declined in the plural in the very same way.» — DLI, Lesson 48.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.
